_about: Hand-picked 'Key reads' that always show at the top of the What's changing page, regardless of age. Aim for 2-4 per path tag so every filter has something. date: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, or null; note: optional short context shown under the headline.

items.title: The Labor Market for Recent College Graduates
items.source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
items.note: Updated quarterly. Unemployment, underemployment, and outcomes by major for grads 22–27.

items.title: Do Job Postings Show Early Labor Market Effects of AI?
items.note: Finds it hard to pin the entry-level hiring slowdown on AI alone.

items.title: Canaries in the Coal Mine? Six Facts about the Recent Employment Effects of Artificial Intelligence
items.note: Payroll-data study of early-career workers in AI-exposed jobs; updated as new data comes in.

items.title: How AI may reshape career pathways to better jobs
items.note: Focuses on the 70 million workers without four-year degrees and the job ladders they climb.

items.title: New grads looking for work: the struggle is real
items.note: Where postings for new graduates are and aren't holding up.

items.title: More Americans think AI will take people's jobs than 2 years ago
items.note: Opinion survey of U.S. adults, June 22–28, 2026. Measures expectations, not outcomes.

items.title: Wind turbine service technicians employment projected to grow 49.9 percent from 2024 to 2034
items.note: The 15 fastest-growing occupations, several in skilled trades and healthcare.

items.title: Employment Projections: 2024–2034
items.note: The official 10-year outlook by occupation. Next edition expected in late summer.

items.title: The Impact of Registered and Unregistered Apprenticeship: Evidence from the Scaling Apprenticeship and Closing the Skills Gap Grants
items.source: U.S. Department of Labor, Chief Evaluation Office
items.note: Independent evaluation (Urban Institute): registered apprenticeships raised employment and earnings about two years after enrollment, especially in IT, healthcare and advanced manufacturing.

items.title: Top State for Talent Pre-Apprenticeship and Apprenticeship Program
items.note: Georgia's state-funded apprenticeship program, expanded and renamed in July 2026. Funds employers that create apprenticeships.

items.title: How Apprenticeships Can Benefit Young People and Employers Alike
items.note: Youth apprenticeships for high schoolers: how they work, and why definitions vary from state to state.

items.title: Apprentices by State Dashboard
items.note: Official counts of active apprentices and completers. Filter to Georgia.

items.title: Employment Situation of Veterans — 2025
items.note: Annual report on veterans' jobs and unemployment, including post-9/11 veterans.

items.title: Air, Space Forces hit recruitment goals, set higher 2027 targets
items.note: Every active service met its fiscal 2026 recruiting goal; Air Force and Space Force goals rise for 2027.

items.title: Military recruiting up as youth unemployment rises
items.note: Why recruiting rebounded, including a weaker youth job market, and why the Army says most young people can't qualify to serve.
